**Welcome – Jeffrey Staff Guide**

This channel is auto‑maintained by Jeffrey and pinned for quick reference.

**Setup & Admin**
• /setup – Re‑run channel setup (docs, queues, pins).
• Permissions: Jeffrey needs Manage Channels/Roles, Manage Messages, Threads, and basic message perms. If something looks off, a health‑check message will include a ‘Fix Permissions’ link and ‘Run setup again’ button.

**Queues (FREE)**
• Staff panel: #staff-queues → select queue, Shuffle/Clear, Blacklist users, Edit queue.
• Student panel: #student-queues → students pick a queue and Join/Leave.
• Blacklist prevents joins and removes listed users from queues.

**Events (FREE)**
• /createevent – Opens a modal to create an event visible via /viewevents.
• /viewevents – Shows upcoming events (ephemeral).

**Study Tips (FREE)**
Automated reminders that prompt students to take a focused study block. Configure with `/study_tips` (Manage Server required):
• enable / disable – turn scheduled reminders on or off.
• set_time time:<HH:MM 24h> timezone:<IANA tz> – e.g., 12:00 Europe/London.
• set_frequency days:<14|7|3|1> – every two weeks, weekly, every 3 days, or daily.
• set_target channel:<#channel> – where reminders are posted (defaults to #student-docs).
• open_panel – posts a pinned control panel in #study-tip-settings with buttons (Enable/Disable, More/Less often, Set time).

**AI Features (PREMIUM 🔒)**
• Code Review: Reply to code blocks with Yes/No. ‘Yes’ DMs (or threads) a review.
• Q&A Assistant: Ask a question ending with ‘?’ → choose Yes/No for private help or a thread.
• History Search: DM Jeffrey natural‑language questions (e.g., ‘who asked about arrays?’, ‘what was discussed last Friday?’).

Notes: Premium is per user or per server via Discord App Directory. When entitlement is missing Jeffrey replies with a ‘Premium required’ card.

**Guidelines**
• Keep discussions professional; avoid sensitive personal data in chats.
• Be transparent when a response is AI‑generated.
• Respect channel topics and thread context to keep history useful.

**Troubleshooting**
• Missing channels or pins → run /setup (Manage Server).
• Missing permissions → use the ‘Fix Permissions’ button then ‘Run setup again’.
• Commands not visible → wait a few seconds after invite; Jeffrey also registers per‑guild automatically.
docs.student:
**Welcome – About Jeffrey**

Jeffrey helps with queues, events, and (optionally) AI‑powered assistance.

**What you can do**
• Queues (FREE): Open #student-queues → pick a queue, then **Join** or **Leave**.
• Events (FREE): /viewevents to see upcoming events.
• AI Help (PREMIUM 🔒):
  – Code Review: When you post a code block, click **Yes** to get a review in DM or a thread.
  – Q&A: Ask a question ending with ‘?’ and choose Yes/No for private help or a thread.
  – History Search in DMs: Ask about previous conversations (e.g., ‘who mentioned arrays last week?’).

**Good practice**
• Don’t paste secrets (API keys, passwords).
• Provide enough context for reviews (language, framework, errors).
• Be respectful in queues and threads; your messages are summarized for history.
